method: Direct view of final background Godot overviews and actual48px light/dark alpha check of generated archive bay.

checks: The underground canal separates two staggered work yards. Wooden bridge surfaces only cross water; stone landings clarify turns along yard walls.
Both repair crews have continuous walls, a two-cell south opening and reachable south-facing device handoff positions. Lamps and supplies do not block doors.
North stairs retain their complete native silhouette. All public walkable cells form one connected component.
The west device is closer and the east device is deeper. The central two-cell stone bridge crosses actual water and lands on connected walkways.
Outer and wing walls have real openings; all columns and devices retain their complete blocking footprints. Cross-material paths meet without background cracks.
Original chapter-five ivory and sandstone tiles match the muted architecture; no shared image or game rule was changed.
The north archive faces the central south return corridor. Wooden reading wings with bookcases and desks distinguish library interiors from the stone court.
West reading room has south/east openings; east reading room has south/west openings. Each entire 3x3 furnishing module blocks movement; public aisles remain connected.
North side rooms and a rear maintenance gap intentionally remain closed, matching the existing dialogue. They contain no deployment, actor, objective or false interaction.
The new 48x48 transparent furnishing was directly viewed on light/dark backgrounds and at game size. Complete shelf, desk and stool contours remain visible without white fringe.

limitations: Overviews contain no active units or UI; ordinary-input play is independently recorded by root.
S51 intentionally sealed north rooms and rear maintenance gap contain no gameplay anchor; all public rooms and task positions are reachable.
